messages.subject: Manually calculating global density
parts:
Hello,

Currently, I am estimating variation in density of Gopher Tortoises across various habitats at a large study site. Separate surveys were designed and analyzed for each habitat type (scrub, pine, prairie) using Distance software. I would like to manually calculate the global density and confidence interval for the entire site, but I'm having a hard time tracking down the appropriate formulas. I have included some details about the models in question.

The scrub model was not stratified.
The pine model was stratified by pine flatwoods and pine plantations.
The prairie model was a cluster analysis of detected burrows with mean cluster size corresponding the the occupancy rate to convert burrows to tortoises. This model was also stratified by dry and mesic prairies. 

Could you please point me in the right direction?

Best,
Kammie
